item.title: Markets rise, but SpaceX and Tesla stocks fall, after Dems take back the House and Senate. Here’s why

The Democrats will now control both chambers of Congress by a wide margin, radically altering the balance of power in Washington....

item.title: Executives need a point of view
item.description: How leaders can bring their own perspectives to public conversations and build trust in the companies they represent. There was a time when executives could hide behind a brand. Not anymore. Today, people want to know the humans behind the companies they buy from, work for, and invest in. They also expect them to sound like people, not talking points with the life edited out of them....

item.title: AI won’t end developer jobs
item.description: Developers will become software engineers with influence far beyond code. I’ve known hundreds of software developers during my career in financial services. Maybe even thousands. What nearly all of them share is the pride and respect they have for the craft. Good code takes time, discipline, and judgment.
